arabic text: (HAAYE ASGHAR, HAAYE ASGHAR)\n(GODI ME AAWO ASGHAR, JULA TERA JULAUN)\nO ASGHAR, O ASGHAR
english translation text: COME TO ME ASGHAR, I WILL ROCK YOUR CRADLE

arabic text: RATON KO JAG KAR ME LORI TUMHE SUNAUN
english translation text: I WILL STAY AWAKE AT NIGHT, AND SING YOU A LULLABY

arabic text: (GODI ME AAWO ASGHAR, JULA TERA JULAUN)
english translation text: COME TO ME ASGHAR, I WILL ROCK YOUR CRADLE

arabic text: BE TEYGH RAN MEI TU AUR, QATIL KA SAAMNA THA\nDIL TUT TA HAI MERA, TU LOT KE NA AAYA
english translation text: YOU FACED THE ENEMIES ON THE BATTLEFIELD WITHOUT A SWORD\nMY HEART IS BREAKING, YOU NEVER RETURNED BACK.

arabic text: KOI NAHI HUMARA, AB KISKO ME BULAUN\n(GODI ME AAWO ASGHAR, JULA TERA JULAUN)
english translation text: NO ONE IS HERE FOR US, WHOM SHOULD I CALL..\nCOME TO ME ASGHAR, I WILL ROCK YOUR CRADLE

arabic text: JULE KO DEKH KAR AB, BETA ME RORAHI HUN\nPYARA SA TERA CHEHRA DIN RAAT DEKHTI HUN
english translation text: I CRY WHEN I SEE YOUR EMPTY CRADLE\nI SEE YOUR BEAUTIFUL FACE DAY AND NIGHT (ON THE SPEAR)

arabic text: KYA BEET TI HAI MUJHPAR KAISE TUJHE BATAUN\n(GODI ME AAWO ASGHAR, JULA TERA JULAUN)
english translation text: I CAN’T EVEN TELL YOU, WHAT GOES THROUGH MY HEART.\nCOME TO ME ASGHAR, I WILL ROCK YOUR CRADLE

arabic text: DARYA KE PAAS BHI TU, SEHROZ KA THA PYAASA\nPAANI KE BADLE BETA, IK TEER TUNE KHAAYA
english translation text: WE WERE SO CLOSE TO THE RIVER, YET YOU WERE THIRSTY\nINSTEAD OF WATER, THEY GAVE YOU AN ARROW

arabic text: PAANI KE SAATH AB MEI, KAISE NAZAR MILAAWU(N)\n(GODI ME AAWO ASGHAR, JULA TERA JULAUN)
english translation text: NOW HOW DO I EVEN LOOK AT WATER (WITHOUT THINKING OF YOUR THIRST)\nCOME TO ME ASGHAR, I WILL ROCK YOUR CRADLE

arabic text: KYA BEZUBAAN BACHE, JAATE HAI SUWE MAQTAL\nPATHAR DILO(N) SE SAARA, HAAYE BHARA HAI KARBAL,
english translation text: DO BABIES GO FIGHT ON THE BATTLEFIELD?\nTHE BATTLEFIELD IS FILLED WITH HEARTLESS ENEMIES

arabic text: LOT AAWO MERE BETE, KAISE TUJHE MANAAWU(N)\n(MAAN KEHTI THI ASGHAR MERE GHAR LOT KE AANAA)
english translation text: MOTHER KEEPS ASKING YOU TO COME BACK HOME O ALIASGHAR\nPLEASE COME BACK TO ME MY CHILD, HOW ELSE DO I IMPLORE?

arabic text: THI AAG KI ZAMI(N) AUR, THI PYAAS KI WO SHIDDAT\nKIS HAAL ME HUWI THI, BETA TERI SHAHADAT,
english translation text: THE LAND WAS BURNING HOT, THE THIRST UNBEARABLE\nUNDER SUCH UNFORTUNATE CONDITIONS, YOU EXPERIENCED YOUR MARTYDOM

arabic text: YE BAAT JANTI HU(N), SAYE ME KAISE JAUN\n(GODI ME AAWO ASGHAR, JULA TERA JULAUN)
english translation text: HOW DO I EVER GO UNDER SHADE, (KNOWING YOU WERE UNDER SCORCHING HEAT?)\nCOME TO ME ASGHAR, I WILL ROCK YOUR CRADLE

arabic text: PUCHEGI JAB SAKINA, BHAYI MERA KAHAAN HAI,\nAMMA ZARA BATAO ASGHAR TO MERI JAAN HAI
english translation text: WHEN YOUR SISTER SAKINA ASKS ME 'WHERE IS MY BROTHER'\n'TELL ME MOTHER, ASGHAR IS MY BELOVED'

arabic text: BECHAYN HAI SAKINA KAISE USSE MANAUN\n(GODI ME AAWO ASGHAR, JULA TERA JULAUN)
english translation text: SAKINA IS SO RESTLESS, HOW DO I CONSOLE HER?\nCOME TO ME ASGHAR, I WILL ROCK YOUR CRADLE

arabic text: NEZE PE TERA SAR JAB MERI NAZAR ME AYA,\nTHI ME RASAN MEI LEYKIN, IK BAAT NE SATAAYA
english translation text: I AM IN CHAINS, BUT IT REALLY HURTS ME..\nWHEN I SEE YOUR TINY HEAD ON THE SPEAR

arabic text: ZALIM KE PATHHARON SE KAISE TUJHE BACHAUN\n(GODI ME AAWO ASGHAR, JULA TERA JULAUN)
english translation text: I CANNOT EVEN SAVE YOU FROM THE STONES THROWN BY THE ENEMIES\nCOME TO ME ASGHAR, I WILL ROCK YOUR CRADLE

arabic text: TU TEER KHAKE SOYA, JALTI ZAMIN PE BETA\nZINDANE SHAAM ME PHIR, MARJAYEGI SAKINA
english translation text: YOU DIED ON THE HOT SANDS, BEING SHOT BY AN ARROW, MY SON\nIN THE DARK DUNGEONS OF SHAAM, SAKINA WILL ALSO DIE

arabic text: YASRAB KO LAUT KAR ME, SUGHRA KO KYA BATAWU(N)\n(GODI ME AAWO ASGHAR, JULA TERA JULAUN)
english translation text: WHAT WILL I ANSWER YOUR SISTER SUGHRA, WHEN I RETURN BACK TO MEDINA?\nCOME TO ME ASGHAR, I WILL ROCK YOUR CRADLE

arabic text: BACHO(N) KO KHELTE AB, KISTARHA SE MEI DEKHU(N)\nYE BAAT HAI SATAATI, TUMKO KAHAA(N) SE LAAWU(N)
english translation text: HOW WILL I BEAR TO SEE CHILDREN PLAYING\nIT WILL DEFINITELY HURT ME, I WILL NOT HAVE YOU WITH ME

arabic text: ANKHO(N) KE AANSUO(N) SE, GHAM KE DIYE JALAAWU(N)\n(GODI ME AAWO ASGHAR, JULA TERA JULAUN)
english translation text: WITH MY TEARS, I WILL PUT OUT THIS BURNING FIRE IN MY HEART\nCOME TO ME ASGHAR, I WILL ROCK YOUR CRADLE

arabic text: SUNTI HU TEER TUMNE, HALQOOM PE HAI KHAAYA\nTERA GALA CHIDA HAI, TU KHUN MEI NAHAAYA,
english translation text: I HAVE HEARD, YOU WERE SHOT BY AN ARROW ON YOUR NECK\nTHE ARROW SPLIT YOUR THROAT, AND YOU BATHED IN YOUR OWN BLOOD

arabic text: KARBAL KI KHAAK SAR PAR, KAISE NA AB URHAAWU(N)\n(GODI ME AAWO ASGHAR, JULA TERA JULAUN)
english translation text: HOW THEN WOULD I NOT THROW THE SAND OF KERBALA ON MY HEAD (TO EXPRESS MY GRIEF)\nCOME TO ME ASGHAR, I WILL ROCK YOUR CRADLE

arabic text: JAB RAN SE LAASH AYI, KYA HAAL THA 'TEJANI'\nCHOTI LAHAD BANAAKE, BANU YE ROKE BOLI
english translation text: WHEN YOUR BODY CAME TO THE TENTS, THE CONDITION WAS UNBEARABLE 'TEJANI'\nDIGGING HER SONS SMALL GRAVE, ASGHARS MOM SAID..

arabic text: TAN TERA KHUN ME TAR, KISTARHA BHUL JAAUN\n(GODI ME AAWO ASGHAR, JULA TERA JULAUN)
english translation text: 'HOW CAN I EVER FORGET, YOUR BODY DRENCHED IN BLOOD'\nCOME TO ME ASGHAR, I WILL ROCK YOUR CRADLE
